messages.subject: Reminder: February time entries due Monday
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi both,

A reminder that February time needs to be posted by 10am Monday 3 March for the month-end bill run. There are currently unposted entries on a number of matters. Please also confirm any write-offs to your supervising partner.

Thanks
Accounts
